issues: 25517: The explanation incorrectly says a road with one lane per direction cannot meet any overtaking exception. Article 148(10) also allows an exception for separate carriageways with the required road markings; each carriageway can have one lane. Preserve the printed verdict, but avoid the categorical claim and explain the usual two-way single-carriageway case or state the statutory exception accurately. https://aci.gov.it/codice-della-strada/art-148/

issues: 25514, 25525: 湿滑 narrows the false claim to a wet slippery surface; the Italian sdrucciolevole and other explanations mean slippery generally. Use 易滑 or 打滑 without implying wetness.
25517: 接近或驶入弯道时 describes approaching or entering, rather than the full prohibition near or on the bend; use 接近弯道或在弯道内.
